findings.title: Execution friction is systemic across the eligible portfolio
findings.summary: Lead portfolio reports 91 failed-event friction marks; 13/14 population result-signal episodes carry execution friction and 5/5 emitted observation candidates do as well. Independent JSONL scan of 12 workspace sessions found 153 toolResult isError flags on 1647 results (9.3%), concentrated on long user-threads (S1 alone 41 failures / 498 active minutes).
evidence: independent isErrorTrue=153; top toolErrors: ctx_shell:allowlist_block, edit:edit_context_miss, *:enoent

findings.title: Shell allowlist / security blocks dominate controlled-execution failures
findings.summary: Independent scan: 61 allowlist_block events, almost all on ctx_shell. Concrete patterns include blocked python3 heredoc stdin, lean-ctx allowlist denials, and mid-task permanent security blocks. Agents still prefer shell (lead mostObservedTool ctx_shell=1142; independent 796) over safer ctx_* surfaces, so boundary friction is repeated rather than avoided.
evidence: error sample: Interpreter python3 with heredoc stdin is blocked
E1 friction.executionFailures=11 on a validation-repair+boundary episode with only 17 toolCalls

findings.title: Edit/patch context misses create repair loops without acceptance evidence
findings.summary: Independent scan: 42 edit_context_miss / edit isError events (edit and ctx_edit). Lead admission shows withChanges=0 and withReviewedRelevantCheck=0 despite multi-turn harness-config work, so delivery cannot be scored as outcome-supported. Edit failures cluster with subsequent re-reads and re-attempts rather than structured validation.
evidence: topTools include edit=211 and write=98 but admission records no change evidence

findings.title: Four long sessions lack outcome review; efficiency claims are blocked
findings.summary: usageEfficiency.outcomeReview.status=required with reviewedActiveLongCount=0. S1–S4 are 33.3% of analyzed sessions and hold most failure mass (74 of lead long-session failures). Without taskFamily/outcome/friction semantic rows, long duration cannot be classified as complex work vs tool thrash vs idle/resume.

findings.title: Validation-repair class is rare; checks almost never attach to changes
findings.summary: Portfolio availableClasses.validation-repair=1 (only one emitted). populationCoverage.withChecks=1 and that check is relation=no-change-context (lint passed without paired edits). post-edit-validation and change-validation dimensions therefore sit at Present/Unobserved for acceptance, not Exercised.

findings.title: Tool mix is shell-heavy discovery with high path/find miss rate
findings.summary: Dominant tool is ctx_shell; secondary native read/edit/write. Independent fail reasons include enoent=22 and lean_ctx_failed=7 (ctx_find/ctx_ls empty or failed). Multiple sessions re-discover package roots after empty directory listings and lean-ctx find failures, burning turns before productive edits.
evidence: independent enoent=22; lean_ctx_failed samples on **/SKILL.md and better-harness globs

findings.title: Lifecycle demand is real but thinly sampled; compaction appears in long work
findings.summary: lifecycle-demand available=3 emitted=1 (E2 documentation-maintenance → reliable-delivery/acceptance-evidence). Independent scan saw 2 compaction events with tokensBefore samples in long sessions. Compaction+continue reliability was an explicit user concern in at least one autoresearch finalize thread.
evidence: user prompt concern: compaction and pi-continue without errors

findings.title: Multi-model portfolio without comparable outcome attribution
findings.summary: kimi-k3 (535) and glm-5.2 (449) dominate responses; grok-4-5 and deepseek variants trail. outcomeReview.comparableModelOutcomeEvidence=false, so model mix cannot be scored as cause of friction. Treat model diversity as context, not a verdict.

findings.title: Source coverage is complete for eligibility; skills inventory empty
findings.summary: selection complete=true (12/12). sessionWorkspaceMatch preflight: 12/12 directCwd qualified. usageActivity.skills=[] — no skill-invocation series in the activity strip despite skill-tagged user prompts in JSONL (skill loads may be outside the activity metric).

dimensionScores.rationale: User requests in emitted episodes (harness audit, OMP removal, autoresearch campaigns) are multi-turn and agents load skills/context. Source coverage complete (12/12). Ceiling held to Present/Wired because scope sprawl in S1 (498m) is unreviewed and skill activity metrics are empty, so goal-stability is not outcome-supported.

Supported tool surfaces exist and are used, but execution is repeatedly interrupted: 91 lead failed-events, 61 independent allowlist blocks, shell-dominant mix, path/find misses. Permission denials in admission friction objects are 0, yet security allowlist blocks still abort tool turns. Below Wired because failures are common relative to progress signals.

validation-repair class appears once; only one check (lint passed, no-change-context). withReviewedRelevantCheck=0 and withChanges=0 in admission. Independent edit volume is high but edit misses (42) outrun structured post-edit validation. Score reflects observed gap, not absence of editing intent.

Assistant handoffs observed on all emitted candidates (withAssistantHandoff=14/5) but structured completion=0, change acceptance unobserved, frictionConsequence=0. Long sessions unfinished from a review standpoint (outcome review required). Delivery is conversationally closed more often than evidentially accepted.

Lifecycle-demand signals and compaction events show the system hits context/lifecycle boundaries. No reviewed durable learning artifacts (skills series empty; no Memory/Skill update acceptance in admission). Cross-window improvement cannot be confirmed from this sample alone.
